query: I’m evaluating an 80‑year‑old man. For male inpatients aged 75–85 with hepatic failure, during the first 48 hours what was the cohort’s maximum instability score, mortality, average LOS, and how did critical lab frequencies compare to general inpatients?
final_sql: SELECT MAX(p.instability_score) AS max_instability_score, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NOT NULL THEN p.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, AVG(p.length_of_stay) AS average_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN l.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE category = 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id), 0) AS critical_labs_ratio FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.subject_id = l.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = l.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dob) = 1980 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 AND p.age >= 75 AND p.age <= 85 AND p.had_hepatic_failure = TRUE AND a.dischtime - a.admittime <= 48 GROUP BY p.subject_id;
